At some point by 1 ABY, '''files''' of [[Gyla Petro]] were supplied the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]-owned [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[Mistress Mnemos]] on the planet [[Fusai/Legends|Fusai]]. The files, in addition to supplying her species and birth records, also noted her suspected status as an Imperial agent, although Mnemos was unaware of the extent of the details behind the suspicions.
